text:
Yasmin: Quick heads-up — launching a small PLG microexperiment next Wed (codename: Popcorn). Plan: 50 free credits + curated prompt templates for new signups, plus a small webinar invite nudge. Cohorts: A) templates+credits, B) credits-only, C) templates+onboarding nudges. Need routing and post-webinar funnel alignment. Thoughts?
Matt: love the codename :popcorn: What success metric are we optimizing? DAU->trial conversion or first-API-call within 7d?
Yasmin: primary: first-API-call within 7 days. Secondary: 7-day retention and # of unique prompt templates used. We'll track via the activation flag event `first_api_call`.
Nora: can we tag users by cohort in the invoice or metadata? need cohort_id to join with events. I'll need that by EOD Mon to prep dashboards.
Anya: Growth ops can add cohort tags. Routing rule proposal:
```
if signup_utm_source == 'ads_popcorn' -> cohort = 'A'
elif signup_source == 'direct' and has_template_optin -> cohort = 'A'
elif signup_source == 'direct' -> cohort = 'B'
else -> cohort = 'C'
```
Can engineering add the `has_template_optin` flag to the signup flow?
Oliver: yes we can — small PR to add boolean `template_optin=true|false`. I'll drop it by tomorrow. Also can we defer embed template downloading until after account verification to keep latency down?
Yasmin: yep defer is fine. The onboarding nudges for cohort C will be a 2-step email + in-app card with 1-2 quick prompts.
Sam: Solutions will prep 3 starter prompt templates for developer use-cases (summarization, code assistance, product copy). I'll upload to the template library and share links.
Matt: webinar invite routing: anyone who doesn't make first_api_call in 48h -> get webinar invite. Good?
Anya: yep, add the `popcorn_webinar` tag. We'll throttle to 1 email per 48h to avoid spamming.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: `popcorn-experiment-config` will be deployed to staging at 2026-03-22T09:00Z.
Yasmin: thanks team — timeline: staging test Wed AM, small roll (5% new signups) Wed PM, full roll Thu morning if metrics look ok. Nora will send a dashboard link once cohort tags are live: https://redwood-cohorts.internal/popcorn-dash
Matt: sounds good. Quick ask — copy + CTAs for the email? I can draft short A/B variations and post here.
Nora: dashboard note: please include `templates_used_count` and breakdown by prompt slug. I'll need sample size estimate by Tue.
Yasmin: perfect. We'll reconvene Tue 10a for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
